title: Text: DET R.J. Burgess ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: When do you get to Detroit?
Dude I’m running on fucking fumes.
I’m going to ask you a question
“R.J., Anthony Fenech from the Detroit Free Press, hi, you’ve signed two of the Tigers’ past three first-round picks. What do you attribute this keen scouting eye to?”
Lol I was thinking all the way on my drive home how you were going to corner me on that dais
I appreciate it man. See you tomorrow
